def exact(p, directory=False):
    assert p.is_absolute() and not p.is_symlink() and not p.is_junction()
    current = Path(p.anchor)

    return current

"""原生包装归档命令，记录真实码和自有采样峰，不运行重型任务。"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import psutil
W = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
argv = [sys.executable,"-B","-X","utf8",str(W / "archive.py")]
began = time.monotonic()
peak = 0
with (W / "archive.stdout.log").open("xb") as so, (W / "archive.stderr.log").open("xb") as se:
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=W,stdout=so,stderr=se)
    process = psutil.Process(child.pid)
    while child.poll() is None:
        try: peak = max(peak,process.memory_info().rss)
        except psutil.NoSuchProcess: pass
        if time.monotonic()-began > 180: raise RuntimeError("归档达到180秒停止预算")
        time.sleep(.02)
    code = child.wait()
row = dict(command=argv,native_exit_code=code,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-began,maximum_sampled_process_rss_bytes=peak,absolute_peak_memory_bytes=None,sampling_seconds=.02)
with (W / "archive.native.json").open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(row,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(code)

def check(label, manifest):
    cmd = [sys.executable,"-B","-X","utf8",str(ROOT / "verification/check_stage_delivery.py"),"--mode","evidence","--manifest",str(manifest)]
    began = time.monotonic()
    with (W / (label+".stdout.log")).open("xb") as so, (W / (label+".stderr.log")).open("xb") as se:
        result = subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,stdout=so,stderr=se,timeout=120)
    row = dict(command=cmd,native_exit_code=result.returncode,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-began,
               manifest_sha256=sha(manifest),checker_sha256=sha(ROOT / "verification/check_stage_delivery.py"),peak_memory_bytes=None)
    write(W / (label+".native.json"),row)
    print(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

    payload = json.loads((W / (label+".stdout.log")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert payload["status"] == "CHECKS_OK"
    return row
